author: reek
body: MDIC, the management door to the PHY, and the first test in this tree to reach a PHY register at all. Until the model grew one, every PHY-shaped defect in this driver was invisible here by construction: the model granted link on CTRL.SLU alone, so a driver that never touched the PHY passed, and on the I219 -- a PCH-integrated MAC whose PHY is reached only through MDIC -- that is exactly the failure that would have been silent.

author: reek
body: Four readings, and each is chosen so its two candidate answers look different rather than so it can pass.

author: reek
body: The PHY id is read back through MDIC. A model with no PHY reads zero on an unclaimed register, and zero is also what a bus with nothing on it reads, so the id is asserted as a specific non-zero value: it separates "reached the PHY" from "read a hole". It is the MODEL's id and is not measured off any real part, so this asserts the transaction worked, not that we recognise an I219.

author: reek
body: The address arm is the one that proves the transaction is addressed at all. A read of a PHY address nobody answers must come back as the error sentinel and not as zero, because a driver that folds those together cannot tell an absent PHY from a register holding zero. This is the arm that would fail if e1000-mdic-frame ignored its address field.

author: reek
body: Auto-negotiation is asserted as a TRANSITION, not a level. BMSR's auto-negotiation-complete bit is clear before the driver restarts negotiation and set afterwards, so a model that simply always reported done would fail the first half. A single reading after bring-up would have been satisfied by a constant.

author: reek
body: The link arm runs under `-e1000-phy-link`, which makes STATUS.LU require the PHY to have finished negotiating rather than merely CTRL.SLU. That flag is off by default so every existing green keeps the floor it was measured against; here it is on, and it is what makes this a test of the PHY path rather than of SLU.

author: reek
body: Read straight off the bar, before any bring-up, so the pre-negotiation reading is genuinely pre-negotiation.

author: reek
body: Address 2 is not e1000-phy-addr and nothing answers there. The reading must be the error sentinel and not zero.
